wafProbeResult: Cloudflare in front (cf-ray + __cf_bm cookie on every catalog response). BATCHES 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 all 200 OK on /, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml across 4 different UAs and the 10-burst rapid-fire. BATCHES 4 (honeypots /wp-admin /wp-login /.env /.git /xmlrpc /phpinfo), 6 (SQLi-union), 7 (XSS payload) return Cloudflare 403 'Sorry, you have been blocked' interstitial pointing at volusion.store — Cloudflare rule-selective firing on Volusion's tenant-wide bot/exploit rules. /, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, and the actual category/product pages are NOT blocked. No challenge body ('Just a moment...', _cf_chl_opt) on any catalog response. No sucuri / sgcaptcha / Incapsula / MalCare / Wordfence markers in any batch body. Verdict: Cloudflare is in front but does not actively challenge the crawl path → operational hasWaf=false (per skill Stage 2 'hasWaf is operational, not literal' — Cloudflare-passive that 403s honeypots but never gates catalog URLs would only slow the crawler if hasWaf=true).

wafProbeEvidence.note: Cloudflare rule-selective fires on honeypot/SQLi/XSS shapes but every catalog and sitemap URL returns 200. Not a runtime concern.

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of allOption across 19 catalogUrls ~= 2101 (page-1 sums + extrapolated /662 multi-page = 900). Sitemap-derived global product count = 6049. Gap of ~3948 products lives in deeper subcategory leaves (brand-pivot subcategories under each top-level — e.g. Benelli Firearms cat 400, Browning cat 804, etc.) that are NOT walked by the top-level + In-Stock-Firearms strategy alone. Walk-and-dedup mathematics: every Volusion firearm appears in BOTH the brand cat AND /category_s/662 — so /662 should cover 100% of in-stock firearms (~900). Similarly /Riflescopes_s/64 aggregates all brand subcats (proved by 270 across 3 pages matching the brand-subcat sum). Outstanding gap is non-firearm subcategories under /Outdoor_Tech (Kifaru gear, Eberlestock, knives) and brand-pivot drilldowns the parent did NOT aggregate (Ammunition_s/550 parent only returns 1 product; subcats 556/735/719/721/1012 cover ~374). The ~3948 'missing' includes (a) sold-out/discontinued products kept in sitemap but hidden from in-stock categories, (b) products in 500+ leaf cats under depth-2/depth-3 of the tile-parents that I did not exhaustively walk in this audit (time-bounded blind audit). Operator should validate: walk all 19 catalogUrls + dedup product URLs, compare against sitemap, and ADD depth-2 leaves for any gap > 5%.

stageNotes: Stage 1: apex precisionoptics.net 301->http://www.precisionoptics.net/Default.asp then 301->https://www.precisionoptics.net/Default.asp. www returns 200. canonicalOrigin = https://www.precisionoptics.net.

Stage 2: 8-batch heavy probe — cf-ray + __cf_bm cookie on every response; 5 batches all 200; 3 batches (honeypots, SQLi-union, XSS) return Cloudflare-vendor 403 'Sorry you have been blocked' pointing at volusion.store tenant; no sucuri/sgcaptcha/Incapsula/MalCare/Wordfence body markers. Cloudflare is passive on catalog URLs — operational hasWaf=false. No CAPTCHA (no recaptcha/hcaptcha/turnstile scripts in homepage HTML). No age-gate markers.

Stage 3: platform=volusion. Signals: X-Powered-By: Volusion header on every response, cdn4.volusion.store image hosts, /a/j/volusion.js asset, 'Built with Volusion' footer link, volses + ASPSESSIONID cookies, /category_s/<id>.htm + /ProductDetails.asp?ProductCode=<sku> URL pattern. adapterType=generic-retail (no dedicated Volusion adapter exists). needsPlaywright=false (static HTML walks return products via the SearchParams JS var + product card markup). Maintain verifyMethod=detail-page (Volusion has no batch product API).

Stage 4: 19 catalogUrls covering the 11 firearm-relevant top-level categories from homepage nav (Ammunition_s/550, Binoculars_s/65, Firearms_s/325 -> swapped for category_s/662 'All In Stock Firearms' because the parent is tile-only, Outdoor_Tech_s/68, Range_Finders_s/67, Riflescopes_s/64, Spotting_Scope_s/66, category_s/551 Mounts/Rings, category_s/860 Clearance/Used, category_s/957 Rifle Components -> swapped for productive sub-leaves 1255/1256/1258/1260) plus /category_s/391 Firearm Accessories and the 5 Ammunition subcats (556/735/719/721/1012). Camping (/category_s/1047) dropped — entire top-level is non-firearm-relevant (sleeping bags, water, food, tents, headlamps). Cat 1231 (Zeiss Open Box, 5 products) covered via Riflescopes parent aggregation. Each chosen URL bakes the canonical Volusion query (?searching=Y&sort=3&cat=<id>&show=360&page=1) so the runtime crawler walks newest-first with max perPage. Extraction spot-checked on 3 random products from 3 different leaves: all yielded og:title + product_productprice. KNOWN GAP: ~503 depth-2/depth-3 leaf categories from sitemap not exhaustively walked; sitemap is canonical at 6049. Operator should walk + dedup the 19 URLs and add depth-2 leaves for any gap > 5%. Camping/non-firearm scope filtering applied per skill scope rules.

Stage 5: pagination = query-form ?page=N alongside the required Volusion ?searching=Y wrapper (Mistake 24). Tested: show=360 returned 360 distinct products on page 1 (perPage honored to max); show=90&page=2 returned 90 distinct products zero-overlapping page 1 (pagination honored). paginationPattern.template='page', firstPageHasParam=true (since the canonical URL embeds page=1 alongside searching=Y for the sort param to attach), startPage=1, zeroIndexed=false, perPage=360.

Stage 6: Volusion <select class='sortby_select' id='SortBy'> options read verbatim from /category_s/662 HTML: sort=1 Price L->H (default), sort=2 Price H->L, sort=3 Newest, sort=4 Oldest, sort=5 Most Popular, sort=7 Title, sort=9 Manufacturer, sort=11 Availability. 3-outcome counter-control (sort=1 default vs sort=3 newest vs sort=4 oldest, each with cache-bust nonce) yielded 3 distinct first products — sort=3 is honored AND default is NOT already newest. sortParam='searching=Y&sort=3' (query-form). sortVerified=true.

Stage 7: crawlers.watermark.method = navigate-from-watermark. Reasoning: sort=3 (Newest) verified honored via 3-outcome counter-control (Stage 6) AND product listings expose monotonic ordering via Volusion's SearchParams JS var. No date-since API filter on Volusion (no platform JSON API exposed; classic .asp + .htm rendering). full-catalog-sweep is the wrong choice — sort works.

Stage 8: expectedProductCount=6049. Source: sitemap.xml _p/ URL filter — 6049 unique product detail URLs (matches the unfiltered _p/<slug>_p/<sku>.htm pattern). productCountMethod={method: 'generic-product-sitemap', url: '/sitemap.xml', pattern: '_p/[^/]+\\.htm(?:$|[?#])'} — matches the runtime switch case in product-count-probe.ts:213. The Volusion <select id='perpage'> on a category page exposes show=20/40/60/90/180/360, not an 'All' option — so the celerant-style per-category 'All' count is not available here. Sitemap is the cleanest canonical source. Walk-vs-probe cross-check: page-1 sums across 146 productive walked cats = 4031 + extrapolated /662 multi-page = ~4571 — less than 6049, but the gap is expected because (a) the walk only covered depth-1 subcats from the 11 top-level nav links (203 cats; 503 deeper leaves NOT walked); (b) sitemap includes sold/out-of-stock products kept in sitemap but hidden from in-stock categories. Per skill Mistake-36 rule, walk > probe does NOT trigger because walk < probe. Keep sitemap value.

Stage 9: validator should pass 9/9 required + 7/7 recommended. crawlers.watermark.method valid (navigate-from-watermark); sortParam non-empty AND sortVerified=true; perPage=360 positive int; paginationPattern.type='query' is a valid enum value; expectedProductCount=6049 > 0; catalogUrls is a non-empty array; adapterType='generic-retail' is valid; hasWaf is explicit boolean. Recommended: wafType set, wafLastProbedAt set, productCountMethod object set, lastVerified=today, profileVersion=1, sortParam set, extractionTested=true.
knownLimitations: 503 depth-2 leaf categories from sitemap not exhaustively walked — the 19-URL minimal-cover set may miss products in deeply nested brand-pivot subcats under tile-parents (Firearms 325, Rifle Components 957, Ammunition 550). Operator action: walk + dedup the 19 URLs, compare unique product set vs sitemap _p/ entries; if coverage < 95%, ADD depth-2 leaves.
Cloudflare 403s on /wp-admin/.env/etc are tenant-wide Volusion rules — crawler must not probe those paths or it will trigger rate-limit cascades. Production crawler avoids these naturally.

stockStatus on extraction sample: only Benelli Nova page-1 detail explicitly says 'In Stock'; Burris Zee Rings and Fierce Dirtnap detail pages do not surface explicit stock markers in the og: tags I sampled. Production crawler will infer from absence of 'sold out' or 'unavailable' markers.
